purpose: Select one CPU thread count on the unchanged sealed Phase 2 parent before benchmarking any promotable v24 ABI host. This bounded profile may change runtime scheduling only; it may not change weights, graphs, prompts, decoding, quality gates, or comparator evidence.

environment_controls.interpretation: A run beginning above the threshold remains negative environmental evidence but is ineligible to select the promoted thread count.

selection_rule.eligible_gate: The run begins at or below 345 K and completes all 120 observations.
selection_rule.primary: Highest candidate median generated UTF-8 bytes per complete-request wall second among eligible runs.
selection_rule.tie_breaker: Lower median time to first output when median throughput differs by less than 1 percent.
selection_rule.promotion_requirement: The selected parent configuration must itself pass both the median 2x Qwen gate and the paired-prompt bootstrap 95 percent lower-bound 2x gate. Otherwise no v24 speed claim may be promoted from this profile.
selection_rule.candidate_lock: Benchmark the exact v24 graph at the selected count only. Do not choose a different candidate thread count after seeing candidate performance.
